description: Use this when you want a capo chart or capo calculator for a sounding key or chord list. Returns frets 0 to 9, the shapes to play and easy open chord counts. Supply one key or 1 to 100 chord names, each up to 80 characters. Does not process audio, tablature or staff notation; ease counts chord names, not fingering variations.

chords.description: Chord list of 1 to 100 names; for example ["D", "G", "A", "Bm"]. Give this instead of key.

key.description: Sounding key, for example D or Am. Give key or chords, not both.

name: find_capo_options
title: Find capo options
